messages:
alice_support: FYI - Customer @eve_customer hitting 429s for tenant `tenant-82` since 10:12 UTC. Console quota panel shows 0 usage for the last 24h: https://console/rate/tenant-82

 eve_customer: Confirming, our app started getting 429s ~10:10UTC, dashboard says plenty available. Any ETA?

 ben_oncall: Looking now. Can someone paste a sample enforcer log for tenant-82?

 alice_support: Pasting sample from enforcer logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:11:02Z INFO throttle tenant=tenant-82 tokens=452 model=gpt-small
2026-03-17T10:11:02Z INFO reject tenant=tenant-82 reason=rate_limit current_window=2026-03-17T10:10:00Z-10:11:00Z
```

 carla_analytics: Enforcer shows real usage. I queried the metrics pipeline and see no token_count being ingested for this tenant after 10:00UTC. Raw event example from kafka topic `ingest-usage`:
```
{"tenant":"tenant-82","model":"gpt-small","usage":{"token_count":452},"ts":"2026-03-17T10:11:02Z"}
```

 carla_analytics: Hmm dashboard aggregator was reading `token_count` at top-level field, but newer events have `usage.token_count`. Our parser was changed in prod on 2026-03-17 09:55UTC (deploy-bot v5.14) to prefer top-level for legacy compatibility and ignores nested path, resulting in counts defaulting to 0.

 ben_oncall: So enforcer uses nested usage.token_count but console pipeline is looking for top-level token_count -> mismatch => dashboard shows 0 while enforcer enforces correctly. Is that the root cause?

 dave_sre: Confirmed. I see parsing error in aggregator logs: `WARN missing field 'token_count' for message id=... defaulting to 0`. deploy-bot shows config change at 09:55:13Z.

 carla_analytics: Repro steps:
1) curl raw kafka message for tenant-82: `kafka-console-consumer --topic ingest-usage --partition 3 --offset 12345 --max-messages 1`
2) Inspect payload, check `usage.token_count` path
3) Run local aggregator with old schema mapping and observe non-zero tokens

 Temporary mitigation: edit aggregator mapping to read `usage.token_count` or patch transform to fallback to nested path. I can push a config hotfix.

 alice_support: Customer wants ETA. Carla what's ETA for hotfix?

 carla_analytics: I can roll config change to aggregator in staging now, prod in ~20min pending quick smoke. Backfill plan: run backfill job to extract token_count from raw topic for missing windows; estimate 3-4 hours for 30 days of data but we only need last 24h -> ~30min.

 ben_oncall: Assigning: carla -> update aggregator mapping + run prod smoke. dave -> coordinate backfill infra. alice -> notify customer and share workaround (we're throttling correctly; UI will be fixed shortly).

 alice_support: Notifying customer: "We're seeing throttles in logs, console is undercounting due to ingestion schema change. Hotfix rolling in ~20m, backfill for last 24h ~30m. Apologies, will update."

 eve_customer: Thanks for the quick triage. Please keep me posted.

 deploy-bot: Released aggregator v5.14 -> traffic routed. Rollout id=rg-552, user=carla_analytics

 carla_analytics: Pushed mapping hotfix at 10:35UTC, smoke ok (counts now non-zero for tenant-82). Starting backfill job.

 dave_sre: Backfill started (job id bf-778); will post progress here.

 carla_analytics: Backfill complete for last 24h, dashboard reflects usage and matches enforcer counters. Closing loop with customer.

 alice_support: Confirmed customer saw no new 429s after mitigation? @eve_customer

 eve_customer: 429s stopped after fixes, dashboard now matches. Thanks all :tada:

 alice_support: TL;DR: schema drift caused aggregator to read wrong field; hotfixed mapping, backfilled 24h. Action items: add schema validation to ingest pipeline, add unit test for nested token path, and alert when token_count zeros spike. Assigned: carla, dave, ben.
